definitions.gloss: all circles; various fields; all walks of life
definitions.explanation: Refers collectively to different sectors, industries, or spheres of society. Commonly used in formal contexts such as news reports and official statements.

examples.japanese: {各界|かっかい}の{代表|だいひょう}が{集|あつ}まった。
この{政策|せいさく}は{各界|かっかい}から{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: This policy is drawing attention from all sectors.

examples.japanese: {各界|かっかい}の{有識者|ゆうしきしゃ}を{招|まね}いて{会議|かいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A meeting was held inviting experts from various fields.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word that appears frequently in news articles and official communications. Often followed by から (from) or の to describe people or reactions from multiple sectors of society.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各界|かっかい}の{代表|だいひょう} (representatives from various fields)
- {各界|かっかい}から{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}める (to attract attention from all sectors)
- {各界|かっかい}の{著名人|ちょめいじん} (prominent figures from various fields)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各方面|かくほうめん}: various quarters, all sides — similar in meaning, slightly broader
- {各分野|かくぶんや}: each field, various disciplines — more specific to academic or professional areas
